svg.title: Inside a FLOW device
svg.desc: A FLOW host runs the company's core and people's functions in the directions the release opened. Ana's function and her agent's function pass every check and install without restarting the company's code; a function that could leak personal data is refused before its code is fetched; a company release swaps the core while the functions keep running; Ana undoes her own update on the device and gets her old data back. Below, the same function drawn on a screen, as terminal text, as speech and as AI agent tools.
svg.text: The company's app, with people's functions in it
The release opens directions. A function runs there only if it fits, and the company's code never restarts.
